[[Wood Plank]]s are a [[common crafting material]] which can be used to craft [[weapon]]s and [[armor]].

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[material trader]]s.
* [[Salvage Kit|Salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Wood Planks (see below).
** See [[:Category:Contains wood]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Wood Planks see [[:Category:Drops wood]].
